name: EODHD
summary: End-of-day and delayed prices, ticker search and fundamentals for stocks, ETFs, forex and crypto on global exchanges.

api_key.description: an EODHD API token (eodhd.com/cp/settings); the token value demo works for six tickers

notes: Tickers are CODE.EXCHANGE (AAPL.US); for US stocks the .US suffix may be omitted on EOD requests.
Output is CSV unless you send fmt=json (fundamentals is JSON only).
Free plan: 20 calls a day with one year of data; each request costs API calls and failed requests can still be billed.
The demo token (api_token=demo) works on six tickers: AAPL.US, TSLA.US, BTC-USD.CC, VTI.US, AMZN.US, EURUSD.FOREX.

endpoints.name: Get end-of-day prices
endpoints.summary: Daily, weekly or monthly OHLC, adjusted close and volume for one instrument.

symbol.description: Ticker as CODE.EXCHANGE, e.g. AAPL.US, VOD.LSE, EURUSD.FOREX, BTC-USD.CC.

fmt.description: Output format; the default is csv, so send json to get JSON.

period.description: Bar size: d daily (default), w weekly, m monthly.

order.description: a oldest first (default) or d newest first.

from.description: Window start, YYYY-MM-DD inclusive; a different date format is silently reinterpreted.

filter.description: Return one value instead of the series: last_date, last_open, last_high, last_low, last_close or last_volume.

notes: One symbol per request; with no dates the whole history comes back.
An unrecognised fmt, period or order is silently replaced by its default instead of failing, so validate them.
A ticker not carried answers 404 and still costs one call.

endpoints.name: Get a delayed quote
endpoints.summary: Latest delayed price with session open, high, low, volume, previous close and change.

ticker.description: Ticker as CODE.EXCHANGE, e.g. AAPL.US, VOD.LSE, EURUSD.FOREX, BTC-USD.CC.

fmt.description: Output format; the default is csv, so send json to get JSON.

s.description: More tickers, comma-separated, for several quotes in one call (15 to 20 recommended).

filter.description: Return one field only: code, timestamp, gmtoffset, open, high, low, close, volume, previousClose, change or change_p.

notes: Stocks are delayed 15 to 20 minutes, forex about 1 minute. open, high, low and volume describe the session so far; only close moves.

endpoints.name: Search tickers
endpoints.summary: Find stocks, ETFs, funds, indices and crypto by ticker, company name or ISIN.

query_string.description: Ticker, name or ISIN; URL-encode spaces.

fmt.description: Output format; the default is csv, so send json to get JSON.

exchange.description: Exchange code, e.g. US, LSE, FOREX.

notes: The demo token does not work for search; use a real key.

endpoints.name: Get fundamentals
endpoints.summary: Company profile, financial statements, valuation and more for a stock, ETF, fund or index (v1.1).

ticker.description: Ticker as CODE.EXCHANGE, e.g. AAPL.US, VOD.LSE, EURUSD.FOREX, BTC-USD.CC.

filter.description: A section or single field to return instead of the whole large payload.

notes: JSON only. The full payload for a stock is large; use filter to narrow it.
